stage: post-review supplemental analysis, after original held-out inspection
latency_rule: The requested observation at u arrives after prediction/action at u+d. Old observations update the state at u; the updated state is propagated forward. Own initial model becomes usable at original ready+d. Delay contrasts use a common score mask after original ready+168.
planning_rule: Original zero-latency covariance utility and frozen horizons/scales are retained as an unretuned decision heuristic; actual acquisition decisions use only states conditioned on labels that have arrived.
setup_rule: Replay with each instrument fitted on its own initialization but not updated from other instruments later setup; same charged setup calendar and additional-hour feasibility. Adaptive covariance design no longer treats later setup as shared update.
correlation_check: Matched white-residual counterpart keeps original inflated coefficient covariance, stationary residual variance, measurement variance and coefficient drift. Residual F=0, Q=stationary residual variance. Additional white drift grid [.0001,.001,.01] chosen only on Manchester shared pre2021 periodic B48 phase0.
memory_baselines: initial calibration plus latest residual decaying with initialization rho
no current sensor input: fixed initial daily/weekly harmonic mean plus reference residual AR memory
quality: Full replay after removing Warning/rebased/retrospective sensor inputs, including initialization; this is an archived-flag sensitivity and not restored historical data versions.
branch_diagnostics: Optional offline paired equal-budget windows after common history; actual future references may score/update branch replay only, never select primary policies.
outputs: New files only; all original experiments and manuscripts retained.
planning_eligibility: Only instruments with t>=original_ready+delay can contribute covariance to an acquisition utility. Initial states of uncommissioned instruments cannot influence actions.
authoritative_output: results/revision/access_v2; first supplemental access exports are superseded after a staggered-model planning-eligibility audit, retained for provenance only.
